records.name: Canva Craft

officialStatus.craft: CRAFT-1 2K (craft_v1_2k) is Canva's first-party image-generation model; the Image Generation REST API remains Preview.
officialStatus.userAppAuth: Public/private app uses user authorization, asset:write, image_generation capability and the user's AI credit allowance.
officialStatus.serviceAppAuth: Service apps are also supported for this REST endpoint through client credentials and service:asset:write; CRAFT-1 2K costs 3 credits per 2K image from the team's API credit pool.
officialStatus.serviceAppEligibility: Service apps require an eligible Canva Business, Teams or Nonprofit team and MFA or SSO; each team can have one service app.
officialStatus.previewLimits: Preview APIs may change without notice; public apps using them cannot pass public-app review or be made available to all Canva users.
officialStatus.mcpDistinction: Canva MCP is separate: its official guide uses per-user OAuth and says organization-level or service-account authentication is not supported.

records.name: 1Password agent sign-in

officialStatus.availability: Opt-in for Individual and Family accounts on 1Password.com; Team/Business accounts and 1Password.ca/.eu are not currently supported.
officialStatus.minimumAppVersion: 8.12.42 or later on the same device as the agent.
officialStatus.approval: The user approves or denies each sign-in request; the agent cannot approve its own request. Approved items can be reused for up to 30 days.
officialStatus.boundary: 1Password fills and submits the sign-in form outside the agent's view. After sign-in, the website session is controlled by the agent and is outside the password-fill guarantee.
officialStatus.unsupported: Passkeys, sign-in-provider login items and shared vaults are not currently supported.
